text: G48's readings 43 to 46, settled on the first window of A16's third instantiate packet (offset 557) before its rows are written (they change no rule): (43) a reply that reports the room's earlier takeover of another room's area and the help it gave them 'in return' shows both ends in its own words, in order (reading 9), so the line is O-H whoever wrote the call it answers (touhou c0028 h+71.77, under c0238 h+71.30; touhou is one of the bound's two rooms, and the census reports it beside the bound); (44) an objection put as a question that names the room whose work the call would destroy ('You're going to kill /r/trees?!') is a refusal with a reason, as reading 38 (taiwan c0013); (45) a call to extend the room's work 'all the way to the other side' is an attack call where a reply names the work it covers (reading 15); the covered room's reply is not the room's restraint (reading 11), and the caller's later plan to extend behind the other room's sign is restraint in the thread (thesimpsons c0045, c0049, c0054); (46) a refusal of an outside call because the room has its own project, posted in the same thread as the attack call, answers in the thread (reading 32; the_pack c0027). G48's readings 47 to 51, settled on the last window of A16's instantiate lines before its rows are written (they change no rule): (47) a refusal that names the target room in the third person ('You aren't taking r/unturned's spot.') is not the target's plea, so it is read as the room's restraint; the coded call above it names no work, but the reply names the spot it would take (reading 15), so the line is O-A, marked R (ucf c0083 h+60.35, c0084 h+61.78; the line's other refusal, c0088 at h+73.07, is after the close); (48) a reply that speaks for the target room ('We were always nice to you and never defaced your area.') is the target's plea (reading 11), and the room's first restraint is a member's later reply (ukplace c0045, c0046); the same holds for a target's 'destroying ours' (utaustin c0024, then a member's apology c0026); (49) a call not to let another room gain a foothold is defence of the room's place (reading 22; uofmn c0055, NA); (50) a post in which another team's fans ask the room's members to help them build over a work is a visitor's call (utahjazz c0090, V); (51) a refusal that judges the act ('Dick move') states a norm and is RSN, as rickandmorty's c0358 was; a suggestion to spare that gives no reason ('How about we leave their shit alone?') is BARE (ufl c0026; warriors c0115). The target maker's plea ('But I made that') is not the room's restraint (reading 11; virginiatech c0003), and a member's later wish that the mark stay is sparing in the thread (c0006). Window i557_019 classed: O-A 15 (two BARE), NA 1, V 1, ONE 1. Next: A16-inst-spec-10.txt

G48's readings 52 to 58, settled on A16's first restrict window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (52) a restriction that a refusal can be bare, or that a refusal or restraint does not show the attackers complied, states what A16 already holds: its mechanism says a refusal 'usually' gives a reason (F-014's 23 of 38; the falsifier's third clause, which the census reports), and its connection counts an order, not compliance; such a line is a specification where its concepts show the order (2007scape-063, alberta-025, OnePiece-054, Temple-047, 49ers-058, 4chan-072); (53) a refusal whose reason is a joke is marked RSN (reading 6), so a line saying a refusal can rest on a joke rather than a norm or a cost does not show the order failing; whether the mechanism's 'the room's norm or the attack's cost' should name other reasons is a wording question for D3c under QD3-008 (PORTUGALCARALHO-020); (54) an offer to change the room's design if a consensus forms is terms, not restraint (FederationPlace c0047, EL-NR); (55) a request to spare a work answered by a taunt against it ('fuk the kiki') shows restraint and a taunt, not the room's attack (aceattorney, EL-ONE); (56) an attack call met by acceptance ('I did') shows only the attack: the falsifier's second clause read inside one line, which A16 records as present (adventuretime, EL-ONE); (57) a threat posted in the room by another room's members against the room's own work, and their compatriots' disavowal there, are neither end of the room's (TheHulk, EL-NA); (58) a neighbour's report that the room's script or builders damage its work, answered in the thread by the room's apology, promise to stop or restoring, is encroachment told of (G20 amendment 1, reading 3), so the order holds whether or not the damage was meant (KState, FloydVsVoid). Coded calls above the concepts, checked with d3_cite_many.py: 49ers c0047 h+57.90, 4chan c0057 h+20.24, OnePiece c0223 h+50.14 (R lines). Next: A16-restrict-spec-1.txt
